parse.title: Sea God (Tyrant of the Seas)
parse.text:
Story Mode Meta Unit
This unit is one of the most effective units in the game for Story Mode!
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 15.5 - Summer update

Overview

Sea God (Tyrant of the Seas)​ is a Secret Limited unit​​. He can only be obtained by evolving Sea God.

Evolving

Sea God (Tyrant of the Seas) can be evolved from Sea God with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Sea God
x1 Sea God's Trident Sea God's Trident
x12 Star Fruit
x5 Star Fruit (Blue)
x3 Star Fruit (Pink)
x4 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Sea God (Tyrant of the Seas)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5,000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
